title: Place
description: A place in the Record: a public space, a corridor, a building or parcel, or a private property, unit or area. Reality Context Protocol 0.1.

level.description: map: public places, parcels, buildings and their rules. space: one property and what's in it.

tier.description: commons: anyone can read it. private: only the place's members can.

parts.description: Other places this one is made of, by id. A national project lists its corridors; a corridor lists its sites.

geometry.description: Path to a GeoJSON file, relative to this file.

captures.description: Path to the captures.csv that lists what exists here now.

facts.description: Path to the folder of fact tables (CSV with source_ids).
